caseNameFull: Rodney K. TADLOCK v. Anthony FOXX, Secretary of Transportation.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until June 29, 2015, within which to *2830pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
